initialization: Both arms use exact original C148 routed final step12; cyclic off-diagonal coefficients start at zero; reset Adam moments.
fixed_change: Add exactly one cyclic coupling pattern roll(u,1); do not search permutations, temperatures, charts, seeds or checkpoints. Same frozen V, original writer, router, all84 data, objective and schedule.
router: Original C148 fixed three-prototype router and normalizer reused exactly; only prewrite coordinates/projected raw proposal enter routing.
effective_control: Diagonal e=w@A, shape36. Coupled e=stack(w@A_diag,w@A_cross), shape2x36.
proposal: u=V@(raw-prepared); s=e*u (diagonal) or e[0]*u+e[1]*roll(u,1) (coupled); point=float32(raw+V.T@s). Cyclic wrapping is fixed in the archived V row order, not a certified geometry or optimal coupling.
regularizer: .001*sum(e**2)/36 in either arm; identical to original diagonal regularizer when cross block is zero. Regularization normalization changes with rank only in synthetic tests.
objective: R_i=relu(max(abs(response_i))/.0018-1)^2; G_i=read_hinge(.075)+KL_hinge(.0045)+radius_hinge(20)+regularizer. J=.9*max_i R_i+.1*mean_i R_i+mean_i G_i; exact maxima average ties.
final_checkpoint: Only fixed step12 in each arm; no arm selection or deployment.
preflight: Reopen six pinned originals, reuse the sealed C149 prior audit receipt, independently check all84 origin rows, actual tensors and336 archived points/672 native gates, then replay all84 prepared/raw/C146/C148 endpoints; all zero and both warm functional comparisons before any scalar backward.
freeze: Both fixed step12 heads and all336 points sealed before two-round672 native endpoints.
pass_rule: Each arm independently requires84/84 original native gates in both rounds, plus complete denominators and replay/repeat consistency. Partial comparison qualifies neither arm.
hypothesis_scope: Cross-coordinate coupling adds expressivity inside the same V span; it does not establish that diagonal control is infeasible, a causal failure explanation, an atlas, optimal pairing or excluded-input generalisation. Parameters and optimizer geometry differ between arms.
derivative_path: Scalar AD to state-effective control leaf (36 or2x36), then fixed linear router pullback; no full response Jacobian.
scope: Offline two-arm exposed84 training qualification only. C149 diagnostics motivate a declared structural test, not a proven failure cause.
